_doc: M3-B1 golden: bit-for-bit round trips of the satk RW writers on the vanilla game (gta-sa-clean, SA 1.0 US). Recompute: satk rw roundtrip --json (satk), satk rw roundtrip --engine rwfury --json (baseline). Checked by tests/rw/test_game.py. Only numbers, no assets.

_classes.restamp:skin-used-bone-order: SA -> VC -> SA: the VC (RW < 3.4) Skin PLG has no used-bone list; librw rebuilds it sorted, Rockstar stored first-use order
_classes.restamp:skin-used-bone-set: sbmost.dff lists a bone that no vertex weights
_classes.restamp:source-not-3.6.0.3: RW 0x35000 files (models/generic, models/grass, ...): the cycle stamps them 3.6.0.3

_classes.decode/json-error/canonical:error: models/coll/peds.col, a Vice City leftover the game never loads: 2 records with broken bodies, 2 with faces beyond the vertex list (kept byte for byte, refused as JSON)
_classes.embedded_split: bloodrb.dff and rccam.dff carry a CollisionModel plugin that is not a COL record
_classes.name_garbage/pad_garbage: Rockstar's files keep junk after the name NUL (all records) and in the vertex padding; JSON export stores it under raw

rwfury_0_6_1._why: model-rebuild writers: the material 'unused' word, frame flags, texture filter flags, atomic/geometry plugins (Breakable, MatFX/right-to-render), string garbage and the COL name garbage are not kept
